description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged hybrid attacks (0.60 or 1.50 each), causes [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Dark 20% (15s)] if 0-1/2+ allies have Attach Dark, grants [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Quick Cast], [Awoken Darkness], [Immortal Abyss Mode] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Awoken Darkness
description.text: Darkness abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Darkness abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Immortal Abyss Mode
description.text: Casts Black Abyss after using a Dark ability

description.name: Black Abyss
description.text: Grants [Dark Ability +10% Boost 1]/[Dark Ability +20% Boost 1]/[Dark Ability +30% Boost 1]/[Dark Ability +40% Boost 1]/[Dark Ability +50% Boost 1] after using 1/2/3/4/5+ Dark abilities
